review.rainfall_context: Above-normal rainfall occurred over most of Luzon except Bicol.
review.temperature_context: Most areas were slightly above to above average, with cooler-than-average conditions reported in parts of La Union, Pangasinan, Zambales, Northern Palawan, and Camarines Sur.
review.crop_stage_context: High value crops were reported in planting, vegetative, and harvesting stages across all regions.

outlook.rainfall_context: Below-normal rainfall was expected in most parts of Northern Luzon, Zambales, and Bataan. Near-normal rainfall was expected over the rest of the country outside other listed below-normal areas.
outlook.temperature_context: Near-average to warmer-than-average temperatures were expected over most areas, with some Southern Luzon areas slightly cooler than average.
outlook.enso_summary: Moderate to strong El Nino was present. PAGASA expected it to continue into the first half of 2027.
